notes.title: Hotfix 01 for Mirage Creative 04a1
notes.content:
Hi dear Steam users,

I forgot to include some files in MC04a1 Unity project and it may cause an importing error for some Daz assets. 
You need to go inside this folder \Packages\com.morganavr.daz\Editor\Importer\Shaders and remove all files inside it.
Then you need to extract Hotfix01.7z archive somewhere and move all its content inside that Shaders folder. Do it when Unity is NOT launched.

You can get access to Hotfix01.7z in two ways:
1) By sending me a Private Message on Steam forums
2) On my Discord server in #steam channel. To view this channel you need to have "Steam" role assigned to you. You can request Steam role here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1245780/discussions/0/2949250308629065633/

-M

notes.title: Please make a backup of your looks/scenes files in preparation of Mirage update
notes.content:
Hello dear Steam users,

Soon I will release Mirage 0.4-beta-1. During this automatic update Steam will automatically erase all content inside Mirage directory including your scenes and looks files. On my PC they are located at:
F:\Games\Steam\steamapps\common\MirageByMorganaVR\Mirage_Data\StreamingAssets\looks
F:\Games\Steam\steamapps\common\MirageByMorganaVR\Mirage_Data\StreamingAssets\poses
F:\Games\Steam\steamapps\common\MirageByMorganaVR\Mirage_Data\StreamingAssets\scenes

New Mirage version will save/load user files from C:\Users\YOUR_NAME\Documents\My Games\Mirage folder so all future game updates won't affect your save files anymore but for this update this manual copy/pasting of files will be required.

Best, M

notes.title: Mirage 0.4 August Progress Report
notes.content:
Hi dear Steam users,

I tried very hard to finish and release Mirage 04-beta-1 in August, I even found myself working on PC until 4AM in the morning quite often, but due to the unstable Importer's work I decided to take additional two weeks to polish everything. Areas of the Importer that will be improved during these two weeks include:

* Unstable work in Asset Import Pipeline which results in this bug: some assets are not created

* Background tasks freeze sometimes

* Upon importing of new character resources/settings of the existing models are overwritten with bad data because of complex dependency tree structure


In the next seven days I'll try to fix the biggest problems and share a video with working Importer, then, I'll do my best to release 04-beta-1 in the first half of the month and in a worst scenario I plan to release the beta until the end of this month unless some critical bugs appear.

Thanks for your patience.

-M

notes.title: Loading time improved significantly on Desktop PC
notes.content:
Some users complained that Mirage takes forever to load.
I rewrote a source code and now Mirage loads in two seconds on Desktop PCs.

Also I bought another middle specs PC to catch Loading bug but Mirage works without problems there.
PC configuration:
* Core i5-2400 (4 cores)
* GTX 1050 ti (4GB vRAM)
* 16GB RAM
* 120 GB SSD, 500GB HDD
* Windows 10 Pro (version 2004, OS build 19041.804) and then Windows 10 Pro (Version 20H2, OS build 19042.631)

Also I added:
* New start menu to quickly select a girl (click on girl image to load her or click on Menu icon to load a previously saved Scene).
* QR debug codes are generated when a girl is loading. If the game crashes or freezes - make a screenshot of the screen and send me QR code. It contains name of the function in C# code that was called before freeze/crash and it will help me fix future bugs quicker.

As always, please reply to this thread if this update helps and now Mirage works for you.

notes.title: Hotfix: trying to fix a Loading bug. Attempt #1
notes.content: Some users reported that a game could not load at start. I looked at their submitted crash reports and the problem was in third-party library from Unity Asset Store (Highlighter around girls bodies). I removed this library completely and rewrote it from scratch with a different visual effect (transparent boxes around girls bodies). It should fix the issue.

notes.title: Mirage 0.3.5 is released!
notes.content:
Dear Steam users,

I want to thank you for your patience. This version could not be possible without your financial support and without your constant feedback. I read all messages on Steam Community forums and Discord to create the best game for you and for me :)

Changelog for 0.3.5:

NEW: Multiple girls in one scene
NEW: Save/Load Scenes
NEW: Save/Load Poses
NEW: +100 new animations
NEW: Change animations speed
NEW: Improved mouse camera controls (rotate camera around a girl by dragging a mouse button on her, scroll mouse wheel to zoom closer, click and hold mouse wheel to move camera around)
NEW: "Smart selection" feature (works best in VR) for easier posing of multiple girls
NEW: Move multiple girls at once by disabling "Smart selection" on "Models" tab and then activating checkmarks near girls' names.
NEW: "Favorites" category of morphs - add morphs you like there by clicking on small white rectangles on the left side of morph name
NEW: Reset individual morphs to default value by clicking "R" button
NEW: VR photo-camera for making screenshots when you save a Scene or Look
NEW: Change scene/floor colors
NEW: "Full Screen mode" toggle to switch the game to Windowed mode.
NEW: Change UI size by clicking Plus/Minus buttons on your NumPad keyboard or SHIFT and Plus/Minus on your regular keyboard.
NEW: Rotate a girl with Left/RightArrow keys
NEW: Hold CTRL button for more precise posing of limbs/head
NEW: Hold SHIFT button to move limbs/head closer or further from camera
NEW: Quickly reset a scene by clicking on "Queen", "Ebony", "Beach" buttons inside "Save/Load Scenes" menu.
NEW: Outliner. Shows a bright pink border around a girl when you switch "active" girl.
NEW: Highlight a girl each time an active girl is changed ("Highlight girls" checkmark on Models tab)
NEW: Focus mode ("F" button on Models tab, Desktop version) - focus camera on selected girl. Useful feature if you "lost" a girl in a scene.
NEW: Prev/Next buttons for easier scrolling of long lists
NEW: Reset button added to FOV slider
CHANGED: Esc button does not exit a game but switches between Full screen and Windowed modes
CHANGED: All six builds of the game are merged into one codebase (game size is 8GB now, was - 27GB)


********
How to update Mirage?
To update the game close Steam app completely by right-clicking on small Steam icon at the bottom right corner of the screen (you may need to click on "Arrow" symbol first to reveal a full list of running apps) and select "Exit". Then launch Steam again and Mirage should start updating.

********
Why it took you so long to release Mirage 0.3.5?
During all this time (from initial Mirage release) I worked every day on Mirage. On three tasks: 
1) My custom C++ physics engine. It's extremely complex to develop but it's awesome and this is the main part of Mirage I am most excited about. I will share more details about it when I'm ready.
2) Importers of custom characters and 3D objects
3) Mirage 0.3.5

As a result of such time sharing I have written more than 12,000 lines of C++ source code for the physics engine. It's a lot and every line of code is created specifically for Mirage taking human body physics into account.

********
What's next?
Next is Mirage 0.4 - Importer of Daz content (characters, clothes, hair styles).
Working on it.

Then I plan to release:

Unity scenes importer
Animation recording systems (mocap and keyframe based)
Realistic physics for cloth, hair, human body, liquids, rigid bodies
Online multiplayer


Thank you all, guys!
-M

notes.title: About 0.3.5 and physics (synced news from Oct 31st)
notes.content:
---
News from October 31st:
About 0.3.5 and physics

Hi dear Steam users,

I want to be transparent with you. Last 1.5 months I was working on 0.3.5 and also on physics. Time split was 50-50. That's one of the reasons why 0.3.5 still is not released (it's almost ready, maybe I'll release it in 5 days, maybe in 2 weeks, I suck at time estimates, don't want to tell a specific date). I decided to spent time on physics because it's a very complex task and I simply would forget half of the mathematical equations if I did not work on it. But thanks to that time commitment I can confidently say that in near time (until the end of this year or at the beginning of next one) Mirage will have realistic cloth physics. Then hair physics. Then the most complex of them all - character's body physics.


Cloth physics

Recommended way to create new clothes in Mirage will be through Marvelous Designer and Substance Painter - the world's leading tools for authoring clothes and texturing. Also cloth physics will work on clothes bought from Daz store or created in Maya/Blender.


I want Mirage to be the best sex simulator in the world. It requires the most realistic physics systems you have ever seen. That's the goal. So, all I ask from you - just wait. I am improving Mirage every day. Even if you don't see it.


Thanks for being with me all this time and Happy Halloween, guys! 🎃👻 

-M

News from August 10th:
About working fulltime on Mirage

Hi dear Steam users,

TLDR: I will work on Mirage full time. Yay!


Longer version:

Tomorrow morning I will write a formal letter of resignation to my current employer. According to contract I must work there for one more month to finish current tasks and transfer my work to colleagues. 11th of September will be last day at work and after that I will work on Mirage full time, every day. Also I want you to understand that all income for my family will be only from Patreon and Steam. From financial point of view it is a very risky decision to throw away a job and career in pursuit of your dream. But I believe in Mirage. I believe in your support. That's why I will do it. 

-M
